title: Pull-Apart Pepperoni Pizza in Springform Pan
description: A delicious pull-apart pizza made in a springform cake pan with pepperoni, mozzarella, and oregano.

ingredients.item: Half a cup of garlic butter
Two pounds of pizza dough, chopped
One and a half cups of grated mozzarella cheese

steps: Mix the chopped pizza dough, melted garlic butter, pepperoni, oregano, and grated mozzarella.
Place the mixture inside a springform cake pan.
Make a small divot in the middle of the mixture.
Flip over an oven-safe ramekin and place it in the oven at 450°F for 20 minutes.
After baking, release the springform cake pan.
Flip over the ramekin and place it back in the middle of the pan.
Serve with ranch or marinara sauce.
